caption_L2L3: Air cargo at the airport trend is consistent over the period 2010 to 2018.   An initial decline to below 2million tonnes in 2011 did not really recover until 2014 where it remained above 2 million tonnes.  It peaked around 2017 at about 2.3 mill tonnes which was a record and then return towards the 2 million tons at the end of the period.
